verdict.rationale: impots.gouv.fr is a government tax-administration portal for filing, paying and consulting tax services, not an automation or workflow platform, so scheduling user-defined recurring jobs or workflows is a category error for this product type. The CFE direct-debit option (prélèvement automatique) is a recurring payment arrangement, an adjacent feature rather than a capability to schedule recurring jobs or workflows, so it does not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
